//: Local AI gateway. The upstream is a Foundry Local server on this machine's loopback: it speaks the OpenAI wire format and requires no credential, so this route carries no CredProx.Credential metadata at all - the caller's own X-CredProx-Key is the only authentication anywhere on the path, and each caller's Operations list is its allow-list (absent = every operation). Audit records every call with the caller id. Demo keys are throwaway; real ones go in your secret source.

Metrics.//: Console true prints the CredProx meter to stdout instead of exporting OTLP (the default endpoint OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT). Shorten OTEL_METRIC_EXPORT_INTERVAL (ms, default 60000) for demos.
